# Service-registration skill migration

This instruction-only slice contributes to [#799](https://github.com/Gibbs-Morris/mississippi/issues/799)
and the [migration programme](https://github.com/Gibbs-Morris/mississippi/issues/532).
Its issue plan precedes implementation. The user authorized independent
preparation and draft publication; root owns stack integration and publication.
Current CI and review gates remain required before readiness.

## Source map and retained authority

| Former instruction detail | Maintained owner |
| --- | --- |
| All 15 Rules, frontmatter, opening prefix, scope and audience | Retained exactly in the two instruction adapters; authority applies independently of skill activation. |
| Registration Quick-Start and Core Principles | Portable graph/options/deferred-work procedure, with current registration/builder sources in the binding. |
| Domain entrypoint table and ordered registration walkthrough | Existing domain-modeling Rules and the binding's generator/source route; generated paths remain supported. |
| Keyed library/host examples and Core Principles | Portable forwarding and identity-verification procedure plus actual consuming constructors and Spring host source. |
| Module-owned key table and container-default pointers | Linked module-owned defaults and options sources; keys remain owned by each storage package. |

Both adapters link the skill and local binding with direct-file fallback. The
[skill](../../.agents/skills/register-dotnet-services/SKILL.md) contains no
Mississippi paths, APIs, or keys. The [binding](service-registration-bindings.md)
uses current runtime-builder signatures, lazy factories, option validation,
hosted initialization, constructor contracts and host forwarding.
Application code, scripts, build/package inputs, workflows, AGENTS and custom
agents remain unchanged. Revert the complete slice together to restore the
former procedures without altering other skills or consumers.

## Validation boundaries

Skill schema, configured Markdown lint, exact retained-policy comparisons,
JSON parsing with unique IDs, local links/anchors, scope exclusions and raw LF
accounting are checked separately from behavioral evidence. The
[eight-case rubric](service-registration-skill-cases.json) records intended and
negative/collision behavior; it is evaluation input, not an execution pass.

An isolated consuming fixture and executable checker are prepared for a fresh
worker using this chat's inherited model/settings. The checker compiled and
rejected the intentionally unwired starter in all seven runtime cases, as
expected. At the historical preparation handoff, independent positive behavior was
unverified; the fresh bounded result below supersedes that pending status. Native host discovery/full-matrix evidence is not claimed. Copilot
behavior and review remain deferred and unverified; no retry or budget change.
Required final build/cleanup/test and current-head/base CI/review evidence remain
with the root's integration gate; this scoped preparation does not establish
application or PR readiness. Mutation testing was not run for this guidance-only
slice; no mutation score or application coverage change is claimed.

## Fresh consuming behavior evidence

An inherited-chat-model worker selected the supplied registration capability and
implemented only the permitted wiring/lifecycle types. Its build reported zero
warnings/errors and its own probe passed 136 assertions across 14 cases. Root
then independently executed all seven checker cases: keyed identity/deferred
startup, overloads, invalid options at startup, missing keys, cancellation,
initialization failure and constructor contracts passed. Nine protected copied
inputs remained byte-identical; all eleven original inputs were preserved.

The first root attempt stopped before runtime because the worker over-selected
the event-feature capability for a pure reducer request without event-sourced
context. The worker independently corrected only that routing decision; original
decision/failure evidence and all thirteen unchanged non-routing output hashes
are retained. The second root attempt passed; the checker was unchanged.

Exact skill LF SHA-256 remains `2d7fb13290b94850e112ff83cb9d8a17cb5248a29a853932b939696f5af56ad9`.
Root checker/probe hashes are `7d52d7d409662ab3133dc39ecd6cd405e53983568213c963b187447b0cf5b9c7` /
`164ca1c55be155643810ac3321ddc1b5934ec5b5fe8164a95c1ee54dac0fa58e`; result evidence SHA-256 is
`1d606abeb4e42b50ee8d108d10b43608b0e002f59293e2a5bea2278271183292`.
These bounded supplied-catalog/runtime cases do not establish the full native
discovery/model matrix or Copilot parity, which remain unverified.
